verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help docs confirm that manual journal entries can be posted individually or in bulk via a CSV import template. Edits are handled by automatically voiding the original entry and posting a corrected one, which points to a real general-ledger journal entry feature. Missing for 10: documentation that debits and credits are enforced to balance, evidence of memo or supporting-note fields on entries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos

citations.quote: Need to post more than one manual journal entry at a time? Instead of adding them one by one, you can upload a batch of entries all at once using Puzzle's CSV import template.
Puzzle automatically creates a voiding (reversing) journal entry for the original and posts a new entry reflecting your changes.
